title: Czinger 21C vs McLaren Senna: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two hypercars, one famous racetrack, and a lap record that changed hands. The McLaren Senna was a hundred percent combustion, hand-built in England, and sold out before the first customer drove one. The Czinger 21C is a hybrid with the driver in the middle, built in Los Angeles. Which one is really better? The honest answer needs more than the lap times. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on both cars, Autocar, GoAuto, a McLaren press release reported by duPont Registry, and for the Czinger, ASME, Backfire News, GTPlanet and FastCar. Where sources disagree, we show both numbers. Our own arithmetic is labelled, and claims by the makers are labelled as claims.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
